## Project Title

**Simulated Market Research at Scale: An AI Consultant-Training Simulation and Emerging-Industry Insights Dashboard for TBFI**

## Assignment Purpose

The purpose of this assignment is to develop a Construct and Measurement Table that identifies the constructs used in our research project, defines each construct, explains how each construct will be measured, identifies the scale type, and shows the relationship between the constructs and the research objectives.

## Research Objectives

### AO1

Synthesize published evidence on LLM-simulated survey respondents and assemble a clean secondary data set describing customers and businesses in the four SGV industries.

### AO2

Create perceptual maps and customer segments for the four industries.

### AO3

Assess the validity of large language model panels by comparing their responses against the human benchmark.

### AO4

Evaluate changes in consultant performance before and after completing the TBFI Do Tank Simulator using standardized skill-checkpoint scores.

### AO5

Identify which digital marketing channels generate the highest rates of qualified sponsor inquiries and sponsor acquisitions throughout the marketing funnel.

## Summary

The Construct and Measurement Table was created to operationalize the major constructs used throughout the project. The table identifies construct definitions, measurements, scale types, research objectives, and the role of each construct in future analysis. The constructs are aligned with the project objectives involving AI-generated consumer insights, perceptual mapping, validation of simulated panels, consultant training effectiveness, and marketing funnel analytics.
